Best paper award at Undergraduate Students’ National Conference
Tuesday, 20 September 2016
18550 Hits
Conferring another feather in the cap and continuing the winning stride, Mr Vidit Panchal (2013 batch)  bagged the the best paper award in the OSMECON 2016 - a national level medical undergraduate conference held at Osmania Medical College, Hyderabad from 17-19 September 2016. He also received a cash prize of Rs. 1600/- being 1st in position in the paper presentation segment among a total of 140 presenters from all over the country. He had presented his paper based on research in the field of visual electrophysiology guided by Dr Ruchi Kothari, Assistant Professor, Dept. of Physiology. Over 800 student delegates had participated in the conference.
